title: Apply martian forwarding filter in Rust
description: At the Rust forwarding decision, reject policy-invalid IPv6 source/destination addresses before route emission, while preserving byte-preserving RX decode. Cover loopback and IPv4-mapped transit addresses and multicast scopes 2-14 per spec 7.3. Add focused tests with an independent expected policy table.
